targets.rawSql: SELECT p.name AS "Product", ti.shop_name AS "Shop", ti.url AS "URL", pr.price AS "Latest price", pr.currency AS "Currency", pr.availability_status AS "Availability", pr.observed_at AS "Last checked" FROM tracked_item ti JOIN product p ON ti.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT price, currency, availability_status, observed_at FROM price_record WHERE tracked_item_id = ti.id ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1) pr ON TRUE ORDER BY p.name, ti.shop_name

SELECT ti.shop_name AS "Shop", ti.url AS "URL", pr.price AS "Latest price", pr.currency AS "Currency", pr.availability_status AS "Availability", pr.observed_at AS "Last checked" FROM tracked_item ti LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT price, currency, availability_status, observed_at FROM price_record WHERE tracked_item_id = ti.id ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1) pr ON TRUE WHERE ti.product_id = $product_id ORDER BY ti.shop_name

SELECT pr.observed_at AS "When", p.name AS "Product", ti.shop_name AS "Shop", pr.currency AS "Currency", prev.price AS "Prev", pr.price AS "Now", ROUND((pr.price - prev.price) * 100.0 / NULLIF(prev.price, 0), 2) AS "% change" FROM price_record pr JOIN tracked_item ti ON pr.tracked_item_id = ti.id JOIN product p ON ti.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT price, currency FROM price_record WHERE tracked_item_id = pr.tracked_item_id AND observed_at < pr.observed_at ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1) prev ON TRUE WHERE $__timeFilter(pr.observed_at) AND prev.price IS NOT NULL AND prev.currency = pr.currency AND prev.price <> pr.price ORDER BY pr.observed_at DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT observed_at AS time, price AS value, currency AS metric FROM price_record WHERE tracked_item_id = $tracked_item_id AND $__timeFilter(observed_at) ORDER BY observed_at

SELECT e.as_of AS time, CASE WHEN '$base' = 'EUR' THEN e.rate ELSE e.rate / b.rate END AS value, e.quote AS metric FROM exchange_rate e LEFT JOIN exchange_rate b ON b.as_of = e.as_of AND b.quote = '$base' AND '$base' <> 'EUR' WHERE e.quote IN ($currency) AND $__timeFilter(e.as_of) ORDER BY e.as_of

list.name: product_id
list.label: Product
list.query: SELECT name AS __text, id::text AS __value FROM product ORDER BY name

list.name: tracked_item_id
list.label: Tracked item
list.query: SELECT COALESCE(p.name || ' @ ' || ti.shop_name, ti.url) AS __text, ti.id::text AS __value FROM tracked_item ti JOIN product p ON ti.product_id = p.id ORDER BY p.name, ti.shop_name

list.name: currency
list.label: Currency
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT quote FROM exchange_rate ORDER BY quote

list.name: base
list.label: Base
list.query: SELECT 'EUR' AS quote UNION SELECT DISTINCT quote FROM exchange_rate ORDER BY quote
